charge.name: Charge
charge.description: Lunge forward with explosive force, dealing damage to all enemies in the impact zone and leaving them stunned.

power.name: Power
power.description: Increases the damage dealt by the caster and all nearby allies by a raw amount for the duration. True strength requires neither skill nor subtlety, only overwhelming force.

pressure.name: Pressure
pressure.description: Delivers a devastating overhead strike with a heavy longsword, the sheer pressure of the swing preceding the blade.

powerstorm.name: PowerStorm
powerstorm.description: Channeling the sword's fiery momentum triggers a cataclysmic storm of flame and thunder against the enemy. When nature needs a consultant on devastation, it turns to the guy swinging burning metal.

deflagration.name: Deflagration
deflagration.description: Unleashes a blazing line of fire that incinerates all matter in its wake. Because sometimes the only way to solve a problem is to burn a corridor through it.

wrath.name: Senshi's Wrath
wrath.description: Succumbing to blinding rage, the caster unleashes a devastating strike that obliterates the target before them. Anger management was never really an option anyway.

slash.name: Slash
slash.description: A quick, powerful strike dealing significant damage to a single target within close range.

jump.name: Jump
jump.description: Jump to any targeted cell within range, bypassing obstacles and positioning for tactical advantages.

rage.name: Rage
rage.description: Boosts the damage output of the Senshi or an ally for several turns, enhancing any attacks.

vanish.name: Vanish
vanish.description: Merges with the shadows, becoming untouchable for a brief moment.

shadow_attack.name: Shadow Attack
shadow_attack.description: Molds ambient shadow into a seeking projectile that assaults the foe's body and mind alike. The darkness was going to consume them anyway — you're just expediting the inevitable.

mutilation.name: Mutilation
mutilation.description: Delivers a rapid succession of precision stabs that transforms enemies into leaking vessels. The road to victory is paved with many, many small holes.

shadow_trap.name: Shadow Trap
shadow_trap.description: Envelops adjacent enemies in a chocking haze of poison. The gift that keeps on giving, long after the fighting's done.

arise.name: Arise
arise.description: Raises the fallen commander Igris from his eternal rest to serve once more in battle.

death_attack.name: Death Attack
death_attack.description: A decisive attack designed to end lives.

trap.name: Trap
trap.description: Places an invisible trap on the ground that detonates for damage when an enemy steps on it.

unfazed.name: Unfazed
unfazed.description: Grants immunity to trap effects for the turn and may heal or strengthen the Yajin if he pass over one.

flying_soul.name: Flying Soul
flying_soul.description: Sends out a soul projectile that deals damage to an enemy, effective at medium to long range.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.description: Empowers the caster with gathering wrath, increasing raw damage output with each successive strike received.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.description: The caster places himself between the danger and his allies, absorbing the damage intended for those around him. Pain is the only currency a berserker truly understands, and business is booming.

senzu.name: Senzu
senzu.description: Drains some of the caster's vitality and distributes it to nearby allies. The self-sacrifice seems noble until you realize that someone has to be left standing afterward.

haki.name: Haki
haki.description: Force nearby enemies to target you

unleashed.name: Unleashed
unleashed.description: Deal damage equal to your missing HP

bramble.name: Bramble
bramble.description: Summon thorny vines that root and damage enemies

centipede.name: Centipede
centipede.description: Poison cloud that damages enemies over time

wisteria.name: Wisteria
wisteria.description: Plant a healing tree that regenerates allies over time

scorchmite_summon.name: Scorchmite Summon
scorchmite_summon.description: Summon an explosive creature that charges enemies

earth_smash.name: Earth Smash
earth_smash.description: Earthquake ground slam with massive AoE earth damage

earth_spirit.name: Earth Spirit
earth_spirit.description: Summon a vine spirit that immobilizes enemies

obscuring_clouds.name: Obscuring Clouds
obscuring_clouds.description: Slow movement and attack speed of all nearby enemies

obscurite.name: Obscurite
obscurite.description: Dark ray that damages enemies in a line

memento.name: Memento
memento.description: Water clock that damages and slows a target

shards.name: Shards
shards.description: Launch water shards at an enemy

zawarudo.name: Za Warudo
zawarudo.description: Freeze all enemies in a wide area

hinokami.name: Hinokami
hinokami.description: Fire glyph that burns enemies over time

frost_glyph.name: Frost Glyph
frost_glyph.description: Ice glyph that damages and slows enemies

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.description: Lightning storm that crashes down on enemies

immunity.name: Immunity
immunity.description: Make nearby allies invulnerable for a short time

dead_calm.name: Dead Calm
dead_calm.description: Rapid water combo dealing multiple hits

mystical_arrow.name: Mystical Arrow
mystical_arrow.description: Fire a magical arrow at a single target

scorched_arrow.name: Scorched Arrow
scorched_arrow.description: Fire arrow that burns in a wide line

piercing_arrow.name: Piercing Arrow
piercing_arrow.description: Powerful air arrow with massive knockback

bubonic_arrow.name: Bubonic Arrow
bubonic_arrow.description: Poison arrow dealing damage over time

swarm_arrow.name: Swarm Arrow
swarm_arrow.description: Rain of arrows covering a large area

storm_white_flames.name: Storm of White Flames
storm_white_flames.description: Explosive arrow with massive AoE fire damage

bullseye.name: Bullseye
bullseye.description: Toss a gold coin at the enemy

dummy.name: Dummy
dummy.description: Summon a decoy that draws enemy attacks

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.description: Bleeding axe strike that damages over time

greed.name: Greed
greed.description: Increase loot drop chance for a duration

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.description: Massive slam dealing devastating water damage

sake.name: Sake
sake.description: Drunken rage: boost damage but reduce speed

hellfire.name: Hellfire
hellfire.description: Explosive flask dealing AoE fire damage over time

summon.name: Summon
summon.description: Summon an aggressive creature to fight for you

lullabies.name: Lullabies
lullabies.description: Soothing song that heals nearby allies

tomoda_rage.name: Rage
tomoda_rage.description: Boost raw damage of allies and summons in range

liberation.name: Liberation
liberation.description: AoE knockback pushing all enemies away

kaisel.name: Kaisel
kaisel.description: Summon a mighty dragon to fight alongside you

roulette.name: Roulette
roulette.description: Randomly boost or reduce a stat of nearby allies

gambit.name: Gambit
gambit.description: Wild strike dealing random damage across all elements

purgatory.name: Purgatory
purgatory.description: Fire card projectile blazing in a line

faith.name: Faith
faith.description: Damage taken has 50% chance to heal or double

godspeed.name: Godspeed
godspeed.description: Charged stab dealing massive single-target air damage

healing_word.name: Healing Word
healing_word.description: Speak a healing spell that heals the wounds of a single ally with pinpoint accuracy. One voice, one target, one life snatched from the brink of death.

heartbreak.name: Heartbreak
heartbreak.description: Channels a siphoning beam of energy that drains an enemy's vitality and returns it to the caster. Compassion has its limits, and the healer knows exactly where they lie.

breath_of_life.name: Breath of Life
breath_of_life.description: Regeneration aura healing all allies over time

stimulation.name: Stimulation
stimulation.description: Infuses nearby allies with invigorating energy, sharpening their strikes and amplifying their raw power. Even a healer knows that the quickest remedy for danger is to eliminate its source.

lin_lian.name: Lin Lian
lin_lian.description: Summon a small, devoted companion whose sole purpose is to heal the wounded. It follows without question and heals tirelessly—the purest expression of the art of healing.

word_of_altruism.name: Word of Altruism
word_of_altruism.description: Drains a significant portion of the caster's life force and channels it as healing to all nearby allies. The ultimate act of devotion—giving what one cannot afford to spare so that others may endure.
